fusions.name: Unhurried Stampede
fusions.desc: Tramples forward in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage and leaving everything in it [Slowed] for 5 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Lowered Brow
fusions.desc: A headbutt that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Ruminant Hours
fusions.desc: Increases your health recovery by 50% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Grazer's Constitution

riders.text: the small hurts close on their own
you get your breath back between things
and everything you have comes round again sooner

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health regenerates 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
